+def _submission_data(cgac_code, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, is_quarter_format=True, frec_code='0000'):
+    return {
+        'cgac_code': cgac_code,
+        'frec_code': frec_code,
+        'reporting_fiscal_year': fiscal_year,
+        'reporting_fiscal_period': fiscal_period,
+        'is_quarter_format': is_quarter_format,
+        'publishable': False,
+        'number_of_errors': 0,
+        'reporting_start_date': datetime.date(2017, 1, 1),
+        'reporting_end_date': datetime.date(2017, 3, 31),
+        'updated_at': datetime.datetime(2017, 4, 10, 12, 0, 0),
+    }
+
+
+def _submission_record(cgac_code, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, is_quarter_format=True):
+    return SubmissionAttributes.objects.create(
+        broker_submission_id=93000 + fiscal_period,
+        cgac_code=cgac_code,
+        reporting_fiscal_year=fiscal_year,
+        reporting_fiscal_period=fiscal_period,
+        quarter_format_flag=is_quarter_format,
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.django_db
+def test_get_submission_attributes_links_previous_quarter_with_unmatched_optional_fields():
+    earlier = get_submission_attributes(
+        91001,
+        _submission_data(
+            cgac_code='073',
+            fiscal_year=2017,
+            fiscal_period=3,
+            is_quarter_format=True,
+            frec_code='EARLY',
+        ),
+    )
+
+    later = get_submission_attributes(
+        91002,
+        _submission_data(
+            cgac_code='073',
+            fiscal_year=2017,
+            fiscal_period=6,
+            is_quarter_format=True,
+            frec_code='LATER',
+        ),
+    )
+
+    assert later.previous_submission_id == earlier.submission_id
+
+
+@pytest.mark.django_db
+def test_get_submission_attributes_links_previous_quarter_for_another_reporting_series():
+    earlier = get_submission_attributes(
+        93001,
+        _submission_data('020', 2018, 3, True, 'FIRST'),
+    )
+
+    later = get_submission_attributes(
+        93002,
+        _submission_data('020', 2018, 6, True, 'SECOND'),
+    )
+
+    assert later.previous_submission_id == earlier.submission_id
+
+
+@pytest.mark.django_db
+def test_previous_submission_uses_nearest_valid_quarter_in_reporting_sequence():
+    first_quarter = get_submission_attributes(92001, _submission_data('073', 2017, 3, True, 'A001'))
+    expected_previous = get_submission_attributes(92002, _submission_data('073', 2017, 6, True, 'A002'))
+
+    different_agency = _submission_record('097', 2017, 8, True)
+    different_year = _submission_record('073', 2018, 8, True)
+    non_quarter = _submission_record('073', 2017, 8, False)
+    later_period = _submission_record('073', 2017, 12, True)
+
+    target = get_submission_attributes(92007, _submission_data('073', 2017, 9, True, 'A007'))
+
+    assert target.previous_submission_id == expected_previous.submission_id
+    assert target.previous_submission_id != first_quarter.submission_id
+    assert target.previous_submission_id != different_agency.submission_id
+    assert target.previous_submission_id != different_year.submission_id
+    assert target.previous_submission_id != non_quarter.submission_id
+    assert target.previous_submission_id != later_period.submission_id
+
+

new file mode 100755

+++ b/mimo_test_command.sh
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+#!/bin/bash
+set -uo pipefail
+
+cd /testbed
+
+
+export PYENV_ROOT="$HOME/.pyenv"
+export PATH="$PYENV_ROOT/bin:$PYENV_ROOT/shims:$PATH"
+eval "$(pyenv init -)"
+
+pg_isready -q 2>/dev/null || pg_ctlcluster 16 main start 2>/dev/null || true
+for i in $(seq 1 10); do
+    pg_isready -q && break
+    sleep 1
+done
+
+su - postgres -c "psql -tc \"SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='usaspending_test'\" | grep -q 1" 2>/dev/null \
+    || su - postgres -c "createdb usaspending_test" 2>/dev/null || true
+
+export DATABASE_URL="postgres://localhost/usaspending_test"
+
+
+case "${1:-}" in
+  base)
+    python3 -m pytest \
+      usaspending_api/submissions/tests/test_submissions.py::test_submissions_list \
+      -v
+    ;;
+  new)
+    python3 -m pytest \
+      usaspending_api/etl/tests/test_load_submission.py::test_get_submission_attributes_links_previous_quarter_with_unmatched_optional_fields \
+      usaspending_api/etl/tests/test_load_submission.py::test_get_submission_attributes_links_previous_quarter_for_another_reporting_series \
+      usaspending_api/etl/tests/test_load_submission.py::test_previous_submission_uses_nearest_valid_quarter_in_reporting_sequence \
+      usaspending_api/submissions/tests/test_submission_attributes_serializer.py::test_submissions_endpoint_omits_frec_code_from_output \
+      -v
+    ;;
+  *)
+    echo "usage: $0 base|new"
+    exit 2
+    ;;
+esac
diff --git a/usaspending_api/submissions/tests/test_repair_submission_frec_model.py b/usaspending_api/submissions/tests/test_repair_submission_frec_model.py

+import os
+os.environ.setdefault('DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE', 'usaspending_api.settings')
+os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'postgres://localhost/usaspending_test')
+import django
+django.setup()
+
+from django.db.migrations.loader import MigrationLoader
+from usaspending_api.submissions.models import SubmissionAttributes
+
+
+def test_submission_attributes_does_not_expose_frec_code_field():
+    field_names = {f.name for f in SubmissionAttributes._meta.get_fields()}
+    assert 'frec_code' not in field_names
+    assert not hasattr(SubmissionAttributes, 'frec_code')
+
+
+def test_submissions_migration_state_omits_frec_code():
+    loader = MigrationLoader(None, ignore_no_migrations=True)
+    state = loader.project_state()
+    model = state.apps.get_model('submissions', 'SubmissionAttributes')
+    migrated_fields = {f.name for f in model._meta.get_fields()}
+    assert 'frec_code' not in migrated_fields

(
bash /testbed/mimo_test_command.sh base && bash /testbed/mimo_test_command.sh new
)
REPAIR_RC=$?
cd /testbed || exit 1
if [ -x /opt/test_venv/bin/python3 ]; then
  PATH=/opt/test_venv/bin:$PATH
  export PATH
  python() { /opt/test_venv/bin/python3 "$@"; }
  python3() { /opt/test_venv/bin/python3 "$@"; }
fi
/root/.pyenv/shims/python3 -m pytest usaspending_api/submissions/tests/test_repair_submission_frec_model.py -q
REPAIR_NEW_RC=$?
if [ "$REPAIR_NEW_RC" -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi
exit "$REPAIR_RC"
